, Reason for Mistake: The Planner directed the WebSurfer to the Wikipedia “1928 Summer Olympics medal table” page and asked to extract the number of athletes per country from it. That page only contains medal standings and does not provide per-country athlete counts, sending the workflow down the wrong path early instead of targeting sources like the main 1928 Olympics page’s “Participating nations,” Olympedia country counts, or the official report.
